implementation_review_points: Avoid a cycle: historical-contract-repair-readers statically imports historical-contract-repair-source, so a successor used by the latter must not itself import the readers/source chain. A lower-level physical evidence reader and finite exact-path policy should be independently verified.

reviewCurrentRosterEvidenceByDocument and authoredUseReviewEvidence are exported helpers and currently enforce exact current source hash. Their public/default path must stay strict; do not accept caller-provided hash substitutions or new reader authority. Apply any exact mapping only inside the owning complete analysis after its independently verified successor and row identities.

Freshly scan whole source population and compare complete symbol keys, all occurrences, hashes and counts against a separately reviewed finite successor, including unchanged/removed/retired obligations and unexpected new rows. Compare exact row identity and all independent evidence for each review document. Same lexical facts alone do not authorize changed semantics; the distinct product review must cover affected calls.

Use exact old path/hash/size and independently authenticated old Git data plus exact literal replay to actual physical after-image; reject unrelated changed files and unsupported predecessor hashes. Return only current physical bindings and no historical product reader or projected bytes.

For helper and composed owner routes, ensure physical cold sweep before relevant supplied callbacks, fresh physical/provided/physical per consumed member, and callback-free full final sweep after all later callbacks. The specified contract does not require detection of transient changes restored between callbacks or per-callback global sweeps.

The repair owner records its loaded image/function identity, and upstream admission plus base owner/stage pins capture those bytes. Changes require acyclic exact successor transitions and explicit final physical/function identity checks, preserving old metadata as immutable data. Avoid making transition packet and generated profile depend on their own hashes.

Verify strict public helper negative controls, unrelated path and mismatched predecessor rejection, cold and late mutations, reentry/exception cleanup, genuine source inspections on both lines and profile reconstruction before broad gates. No report cache or fabricated pass.
